deprecated_yaml_full.title: Supernotify YAML configuration can be removed
deprecated_yaml_full.description: Your Supernotify YAML configuration has been imported into the UI and is no longer needed. Remove the `{domain}` platform entry from your `configuration.yaml` file and restart Home Assistant.

deprecated_yaml_partial.title: Some Supernotify YAML configuration can be removed
deprecated_yaml_partial.description: Deliveries, transports, scenarios, recipients, cameras, action groups and links aren't configurable from the UI yet, so this integration still needs a `{domain}` YAML entry defining them. However, `archive`, `housekeeping` and `dupe_check` are now managed from the config entry - remove those keys from your `configuration.yaml` `{domain}` entry and restart Home Assistant.
